name: peLightbox Gallery Slider – Responsive Lightbox, Slideshow, Carousel, Image & Video Gallery
author: pixelonetry

sections.description:
Pelightbox gallery for make website more elegant and unique with the photos and videos! you can create unlimited gallery, slider!
Pelightbox – supports flare gallery a responsive, touch enabled, mobile optimized lightbox WordPress plugin, which can be used to display single images/videos or entire galleries with captions.
Create unlimited carousel slider, Kenburns sliders, Pan / Zoom Effect sliders, Swipe Sliders with full-screen support and CSS3 Animation.

Easy Customizable, easy to use, and built to support Youtube & Vimeo or Local video gallery ,Image Grid Gallery ,Image carousel gallery,Cover Gallery with black and white effect, Kenburns Slider, Carousel Slider and CSS3 Animation Slider too. There are also lots of effects and all gallery support grid and lightbox. All gallery items will be open nice and smooth lightbox. PeLightbox Gallery supports with 2 most famous page builder plugins Elementor page builder and WPBakery Page Builder.

WordPress Features

  • Qautomatically opens all image links with flare (optional)
  • automatically opens all YouTube/Vimeo links with flare (optional)
  • integrates with native WP gallery
  • integrates with Elementor Page Builder
  • integrates with WPBakery Page Builder.
  • shortcode builder

Image/Video Navigation via:

  • UI buttons
  • Swipe gestures
  • integrates with native WP gallery
  • Mousewheel navigation
  • Keyboard arrows

Transitions

  • Use hardware acceleration on CSS transforms
  • Fallbacks to standard jQuery animation.

Media Support:

  • Images
  • Fullscreen/Boxed YouTube and Vimeo videos.
  • Automatically retrieves cover image.

Caption Support:

  • optional per image title
  • optional per image description.
  • autohide when showing thumbnails (gallery).

Caption Support:

  • Side to side scrolling or Zoom + optional black and white transition
  • Scrolling thumbnails.
  • Mixed media.
  • Mixed scale modes.

Most Free Features:

  • Image standard gallery.
  • Grid layout gallery.
  • Volo Swipe Slider

Most Premium Features:

  • Image standard gallery.
  • Grid layout gallery.
  • Fullscreen Lightbox
  • Cover Gallery
  • Black And White Effects – Cover Gallery
  • YouTube & Vimeo Video gallery
  • Custom video gallery
  • Volo Swipe Slider
  • Vario Slider – CSS3 Animations
  • Vista Slider – Pan / Zoom Effect
  • Vista Slider – Kenburns

External Services

This plugin makes use of the following external services:

  • YouTube (youtube.com) – for embedding and playing videos.
  • Vimeo (vimeo.com) – for fetching video data and embedding videos.
  • Vzaar (vzaar.com) – for fetching video data and embedding videos.

Resources

This plugin includes code from the third-party library Isotope v1.5.25,
which is integrated inside the main JavaScript file (assets/js/main.js).

Isotope is authored by David DeSandro / Metafizzy.
Official site: http://isotope.metafizzy.co
License: Commercial license, free for open source under certain conditions.
Source code: https://github.com/metafizzy/isotope
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

First things first, thank you for choosing our PeLightbox Gallery lite plugin!

You can install the plugin one of two ways:

Install using FTP

  1. Unzip the pelightbox-gallery-slider.zip file locally to your machine
  2. Connect to your FTP area using your preferred FTP package
  3. Upload the PeLightbox Gallery folder that you extracted from the zip file to the plugin folder of your WordPress installation (wp-content -> plugin)
  4. Go to plugin and activate PeLightbox Gallery.

Install by WordPress (recommended)

  1. Login to your WordPress admin area.
  2. Navigate to plugin and click the Add New button at the top
  3. Click the Upload plugin button at the top
  4. Click the Choose File button and locate the pelightbox-gallery-slider.zip
  5. File on your machine and click the Install Now button
  6. On the basis the plugin installs correctly, click the Activate link.
sections.faq:
Can I create image gallery by PeLightbox Gallery?

yes, you can create unlimited image gallery.

Can I create grid gallery by PeLightbox Gallery?

yes, grid is the default gallery by PeLightbox Gallery plugin whene you create the gallery the layout is grid automatically.

Can I create slider by peLightbox Gallery ?

yes, you can create unlimited swipe sliders.

Can I create slider with Kenburn effects by peLightbox Gallery ?

No for create slider with Kenburn effect you need upgrade to premium.

How many gallery can I create?

You can create unlimited gallery by this plugin with lots of options.

How to include a gallery in a post or a page?

[pelightboxgallery id=”49″]`

Can I use this plugin with Visual Composer Page Builder?

Yes! PeLightbox Gallery support visual Composer.

Can I upgrade this to pro version?

Yes, but you need to remove or deactivate the free plugin after insatlled pro version possible if two version is active you’ll have 2 blocks with same featues
